data.title: Bitcoin Mining Faces A Shakeout As CORZ, KEEL, IREN, CIFR Get Ready To Exit, Says CoinShares
data.description: CoinShares said on Tuesday that at least 35 EH/s of computing power will leave the listed miners in the third quarter.
data.keywords: Bitcoin network, CoinShares, Core Scientific, IREN, computing power, Saifedean Ammous, electricity consumption
